title: Penalties and Interest for Filing Late
issuer: Washington State Department of Labor & Industries

passages.question: What does L&I charge when the report or premium is late?
passages.excerpt: We assess this penalty and charge interest when you are late filing your quarterly report or have unpaid workers' compensation premiums. ... No penalty amount will be less than $10 ... 1: Total of 5% of the premium due, 1% interest on the premium due. 2: Total of 10% of the premium due, 2% interest on the premium due. 3: Total of 20% of the premium due, 3% interest on the premium due. 4+: Additional 1% interest each month until the premium is paid.
